settings.title: Shipping Policy
settings.lede: Every UK order ships with Royal Mail, fully tracked from our door to yours. Subscribers never pay for delivery, and one-time orders over £40 ship free.

settings.title: Overview
settings.content: Every UK order is sent with Royal Mail, fully tracked from our door to yours. Subscribers never pay for delivery, and one-time orders over £40 ship free.

settings.title: UK Delivery Options
settings.content:
• Subscriptions — Free for life: free tracked delivery on every subscription order, for as long as you stay subscribed.
  • Orders over £40 — Free (2–4 working days): one-time orders over £40 ship free with Royal Mail tracked delivery.
  • Tracked — £3.49 (2–4 working days): Royal Mail tracked delivery on one-time orders of £40 or under.
  • Next day — £4.99 (order before 4pm): Royal Mail next-day tracked delivery when you order before 4pm on a working day.

settings.title: Dispatch Times
settings.content:
Every order is fully tracked, so you can follow it all the way to your door.

  • Before 4pm: orders placed before 4pm on a working day are processed the same day.
  • After 4pm: orders placed after 4pm are processed on the next working day.
  • Weekends and bank holidays: orders placed on a Saturday, Sunday or bank holiday are processed on the next working day.

Delivery times start from dispatch and are Royal Mail estimates, not guarantees.

settings.title: Duties and Taxes
settings.content: Your country may charge import duties or taxes when your order arrives. Whether you’re charged depends on your order value and your country’s tax-free allowance, if it has one. Any duties and taxes are paid by the recipient, usually at the point of delivery. Your local customs office can tell you more.

settings.title: Refused at Customs
settings.content: If customs in your country refuses your parcel and it comes back to us fully intact, we’ll refund the full product cost. The original shipping charge isn’t refundable. We can’t offer a refund if the parcel doesn’t reach us, or arrives back opened or damaged.

settings.title: Returns
settings.content: We don’t accept change-of-mind returns on international orders. If your order arrives damaged or faulty, email sales@acti.health with your order number and a photo, and we’ll put it right. For returns on UK orders, see our Returns & Refunds Policy.

settings.title: Order Not Arrived?
settings.content: Check your tracking first. If it’s running late, looks stuck, or arrived damaged, email sales@acti.health with your order number and we’ll sort it.

settings.short_body: Every UK order is fully tracked. Subscribers always ship free, one-time orders over £40 ship free, and orders placed before 4pm on a working day go out the same day. Questions? sales@acti.health.
